# onetsolutions_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone hosted by OnetSolutions.

Creating it waits until its name servers are assigned; delegate the domain to `nameservers` at its
registrar (or with `onetsolutions_domain_settings`) for the zone to answer. The SOA and NS records
created with the zone are not managed: add records with `onetsolutions_dns_record`. Destroying the
zone deletes it with all its records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onetsolutions_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

# Delegate the domain to these name servers at its registrar.
output "example_nameservers" {
  value = onetsolutions_dns_zone.example.nameservers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_name` (String) The registered domain the zone serves, such as `example.com`: lowercase, without a trailing dot, so the state always equals the configuration. Changing it recreates the zone.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) `onetsolutions` (default) hosts the zone on the OnetSolutions name servers. `client` marks a zone hosted elsewhere: such a zone is added by importing it in the console and can only be imported here, not created. Changing it recreates the zone.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `project_id` (String) The project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id` when the object is created; changing it explicitly recreates the object.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the zone was created (RFC 3339).
- `domain_id` (String) The UUID of the domain of the project the zone serves, when there is one.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the DNS zone.
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain is delegated to the zone's name servers.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The name servers assigned to the zone, to delegate the domain to.
- `record_count` (Number) The number of records in the zone, including the SOA and NS records managed by OnetSolutions.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the creation, as a duration such as "30s" or "2h45m". Defaults to `10m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the deletion, as a duration such as "30s" or "2h45m". Defaults to `5m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = onetsolutions_dns_zone.example
  id = "3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<project_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id and project_id.
terraform import onetsolutions_dns_zone.example 3f2a9c1e-5b7d-4e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b/8b1d4e2f-6c3a-4f9e-8d7b-2a1c0e9f8d7c/5e7c2a1b-9d3f-4a6e-8b2c-1d0f9e8a7b6c
```
